title: 7- Day Raja Yoga Meditation Course in English (In-Person and Online)
long_description:
Oct. 19, 20, 21, 26, 27, 28, and 31 

6:00 - 7:30 pm (EST)

About this Event

You’re warmly invited to join us on a 7‑day journey into the heart of Raja Yoga meditation, a simple yet powerful way to reconnect with your higher consciousness. Explore the timeless wisdom of the soul, the nature of thought, and the connection with the Supreme. Learn an easy step‑by‑step meditation technique. No previous experience needed — just curiosity and an open heart.
7-day course in Raja Yoga Meditation
• Discover the angel and the enemy within.
• Insights into the journey of the soul.
• Understand the balancing forces of karma.
• Deepen your relationship with God.
• Learn and deepen you meditation.

In-Person EventTo join the event on Zoom : http://tiny.cc/RajaYoga7DayZM

Facilitator: Kanupriya Mor
Kanupriya Mor is a meditation facilitator and student of spiritual wisdom with the Brahma Kumaris World Spiritual Organization in New York City. With a background in finance, consulting, and AI-driven business solutions, she brings a practical, contemporary perspective to Raja Yoga meditation—exploring how inner awareness can help us navigate the pace, pressures, and complexities of modern life with greater clarity, resilience, and serenity.
